text:
ashley: Quick spike — thinking about a minimal loader interface for safetensors sharded bundles. Proposal: manifest optional. Loader should support either index-first (manifest-driven) warmup or manifestless streaming with chunk checks. Warmup decisions based on which path is available.
raj: +1 on optional manifest. main worry is atomicity when swapping shards in. If we rely on header offsets, need a safe handoff to avoid partial-read corruption.
sophia: Can we encode a compact "hotstart hint" in the header that indicates layer offsets + a small integrity checksum? That keeps manifest optional but lets warmup be deterministic when hint present.
dash: If we add hints, keep them tiny — per-layer checksums blow up metadata size. Maybe a single aggregate checksum + small per-block seeds.
ashley: idea: header.hint = {seed:..., map_crc:...} manifest still wins for precise offsets. hint used for progressive warmup to prime KVCaches.
raj: Implementation tradeoff: index-first gives best warmup latency but requires an extra request to fetch manifest. For dedicated infra that doubling of I/O costs matters for small requests. Manifestless streaming can start immediately but may cause readahead thrash.
sophia: Operationally we can use a policy: prefer manifest if object size > 200MB or if "warmup_priority" tag present. Else stream-first. Policy configurable per-deploy.
dash: API surface: Loader.open(bundle_uri, {mode: "auto|index-first|stream"}) -> returns ReadHandle and WarmupPlan. WarmupPlan is just a short list of ranges to prefetch. Example: 
```
WarmupPlan: ["layer0:0-2MB","layer1:0-256KB"]
```
ashley: +1. Also need explicit fallback: if index-first manifest fetch fails (404/timeout), automatically switch to streaming and surface a warning. Avoid failing the whole call.
raj: What about atomic swap? We should require that the object storage write is atomic (content-addressed or a finalize step). Loader should reject header hints if snapshot not finalized. That pushes complexity to ingest pipeline but simplifies runtime.
sophia: For private deployments on air-gapped infra we can't assume object-store atomic rename. Add a lease handshake: loader fetches .lock or .final marker before trusting offsets.
dash: Perf numbers from the spike: manifest fetch ~12ms on avg S3-like store, per-layer streaming start ~1.2ms but readahead multiplies. With 8-layer warmup manifest-first wins for larger models.
ashley: UX: expose telemetry events: warmup.path=(manifest|stream), warmup.latency_ms, warmup.fallback=(none|index-miss). That will feed Optimize.
raj: Backwards compat: many safetensors bundles in the wild won't have hints. Default to stream-first for them and add a migration tool to add compact hints + finalizer.
sophia: Migration tool should compute per-block CRCs and embed a tiny hint blob — we can publish as a CLI: `rwdx annotate-hint bundle.safetensors --finalize`.
dash: infra-bot: ran unit spike tests on s3-emulator, 24/24 warmup permutations exercised, pushing branch spike/loader-hints. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234
ashley: Next steps: write a short RFC for loader API, include the hint schema (tiny), the lease/finalize requirements, and the ingestion CLI. I'll draft and ping on Friday.
raj: Thanks — will add perf microbench for small (<100MB) bundles to justify policy thresholds.
sophia: I'll mock the telemetry events in Optimize so we can evaluate cost impact once telemetry is live.
ashley: cool. Closing spike notes here. :thumbsup:
